bio: Waasmunster’s discerning foodies make up the faithful clientele of this smart eatery. They come for the elegant interior, friendly vibe and top-quality produce, without forgetting the lure of the wine cellar, well stocked in Burgundy and Tuscan tipples. The à la carte lineup embodies the establishment’s devotion to quality. Chef-owner Bruno De Wilde errs towards flame-licked techniques and seasonal ingredients, together with signature dishes like vol-au-vent, tartare steak, asparagus à la flamande or local game in season. What’s not to like?...
